headline: Amon-Ra St. Brown's Slot Dominance
body: Since 2022, Detroit's Amon-Ra St. Brown has caught over 75% of passes thrown his way out of the slot, trailing only Tyreek Hill in first-down conversions from the interior.

headline: T.J. Watt's Historic Pressure Rate
body: Pittsburgh's T.J. Watt became only the second player in NFL history (after Reggie White) to log multiple 19+ sack seasons, maintaining a league-best 16.8% pressure rate since 2020.

headline: Panthers Expansion Legacy
body: Carolina reached the NFC Championship Game in just their second season (1996), making them one of the fastest expansion franchises to play for a conference title in league history.

headline: Joe Burrow Against the Blitz
body: Over the past three seasons, Joe Burrow ranks second in the NFL in passer rating against 5+ pass rushers (112.4), throwing 38 touchdowns to just 8 interceptions against extra pressure.

headline: Green Bay's December Home Record
body: The Packers have won over 82% of December home games at Lambeau Field since 2010, the highest home winter win percentage of any franchise in the modern era.

headline: Maxx Crosby's Non-Stop Motor
body: Maxx Crosby has led all NFL defensive ends in total defensive snaps played in each of the last three seasons, routinely surpassing 95% snap participation.

headline: Patriots Scoring Defense Legacy
body: The 2019-2023 Patriots defenses allowed under 20.0 points per game across a five-year stretch, continuing a 20-year franchise streak of top-10 red zone conversion defenses.

headline: Bijan Robinson's Elusiveness
body: In his rookie campaign, Atlanta's Bijan Robinson forced 51 missed tackles on touches from scrimmage, the highest mark by a rookie running back since 2018.

headline: Giants Road Playoff Streak
body: The 2007 New York Giants remain the only team in NFL history to win 11 consecutive road games in a single season, culminating in their Super Bowl XLII victory.

headline: The Rise of 2-High Safety Shells
body: Between 2020 and 2025, NFL defenses increased their use of pre-snap two-high safety alignments from 38% to over 54% of plays, dropping average depth of target across the league by nearly a full yard.

headline: Analytics Driving 4th-Down Aggression
body: NFL teams attempted more 4th-down conversions in the last three seasons combined than during the entire decade of the 1990s, with conversion rates hovering around 51%.

headline: Lions Play-Action Mastery
body: During their 2023-2024 division title run, Detroit utilized play-action on 31% of early-down red zone attempts, resulting in an NFL-leading 68.2% touchdown efficiency.

headline: Steelers 50-Year Non-Losing Streak
body: Pittsburgh has not finished a regular season with more than 10 losses since 1969, by far the longest active streak in North American professional sports.

headline: Packers Blocked Field Goal Rate
body: In the 2024 season, Green Bay recorded 3 blocked kicks in a single 5-week span, the fastest such team pace in the NFL since the 2014 Eagles.

headline: Panthers Time of Possession Control
body: During their 2015 15-1 season, Carolina held an average time of possession of 32 minutes and 4 seconds per game, second-highest in the NFL over the last decade.
